task: Classify hypermutation status in colorectal adenocarcinoma. Classes: Non-hypermutated vs. Hypermutated. Key H&E clues for hypermutated tumors include dense tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes, mucinous or medullary features, poor gland formation, and pushing borders.

classes.0: Non-hypermutated tumor with more conventional gland-forming adenocarcinoma morphology and less prominent lymphocytic infiltration.
classes.1: Hypermutated tumor with dense lymphocytes, mucinous or medullary differentiation, and reduced glandular architecture.
